action.rationale: Fresh problem with dim=10 and a large budget of 2000 (≥ 20·dim=200) and cheap, deterministic evaluations; probing first will reveal basin structure and smoothness while using only ~12% (~240) of the budget and seeding the archive for warm starts.

Probes indicate a smooth single basin: P5 cosine=1.0 and P4 endpoint_y_spread=0.208 with high gain 0.938, while P3 quadratic R²=0.966 suggests a bowl-shaped landscape. With cheap, deterministic evals, polishing the incumbent (3179.64) with L-BFGS-B should rapidly converge. This matches the fastest path to the optimum here.

Probes show a smooth single basin (P5 cosine = 1.0, P4 endpoint_y_spread = 0.208, P4 gain = 0.938), and the active lbfgsb has exhausted at y = 149.15. Re-polishing with a different local method (bobyqa) from the incumbent may squeeze out further improvement at low cost.

Probes show a smooth single basin (P5 cosine=1.0, P4 endpoint_y_spread=0.2079), and both local solvers reached the same value 149.15 with LBFGSB exhausted and BOBYQA stalled (stall_evals=210, improvement 1.6e-08). With only 319 evals left, further runs are very unlikely to improve the incumbent.
